findings.evidence: Distinct eigenvalue tuples differ at some coordinate, whose single operator separates their joint eigenspaces; Mathlib `Eigenspace/Basic.lean:720` proves the corresponding eigenspace independence under domain/torsion-free assumptions, without commutation.
findings.fix: State joint-eigenspace independence under `[CommRing K] [IsDomain K] [Module K V] [Module.IsTorsionFree K V]` with no commutation argument, and derive the character-indexed form from it.
findings.issue: `iSupIndep_iInf_eigenspace_of_commute` unnecessarily requires pairwise commutation and `[Field K]`; line 241 propagates both restrictions to the character-indexed API.

findings.evidence: Its proof reduces to `Submodule.inf_genEigenspace`, which is declared under `[CommRing R] [Module R M]` in `Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Eigenspace/Basic.lean:761`; no field operation occurs.
findings.fix: Move the restriction bridge to a `[CommRing K] [Module K V]` section.
findings.issue: `Submodule.inf_iInf_eigenspace_of_forall_mapsTo` is placed under the file's `[Field K]` block although its proof uses only commutative-ring module operations.

findings.evidence: `MulChar.sum_eq_zero_of_ne_one` has `[CommRing K] [IsDomain K]` at `Mathlib/NumberTheory/MulChar/Basic.lean:607`, while `MulChar.card_eq_card_units_of_hasEnoughRootsOfUnity` is already formulated for a commutative ring in `MulChar/Duality.lean:74`; the remaining use of `Field` is `(Nat.card G : K)⁻¹`.
findings.fix: State this section under `[CommRing K] [IsDomain K] [Module K V]` and replace `[NeZero (Nat.card G : K)]`/field inversion with `[IsUnit (Nat.card G : K)]` and its unit inverse.
findings.issue: Both Fourier decomposition theorems are restricted to fields, although character orthogonality only needs a domain and averaging only needs `Nat.card G` to be a unit.

summary: Several declarations remain below their natural generality: joint-eigenspace independence needs neither commutation nor a field, while the restriction and Fourier APIs retain avoidable field assumptions.
